messages:
ranjit: Heads up — we have a holdlist spike in us-west-2 for the A100 reserved pool. Finance just flagged an unexpected invoice tied to reserved commitments. Can ops triage whether something is blocking fulfillment?

mia: on it. pulling the holdlist now. any invoice id from finance?

billing-team: Invoice INVOICE-7591. Looks like a credits reconciliation error — reserved delta didn't apply for Feb 28 commit.

leo: I see ~12 slots in hold state with tag=\"billing_hold\". They were created by commit-service after the accounting webhook failed.

sam: are these customer-facing reserved slots or internal test commits? want to know blast radius.

leo: mostly customer reserved capacity (mid-market) — 6 active commitments, 3 warm pools, 3 queued burst slots.

ranjit: what's the ETA to clear the hold? Customers are starting to open tickets. Can we temporarily override the tag to allow allocation while billing is fixed?

ingrid: we need approval to bypass billing hold for reserved pools — compliance wants an audit trail if we do.

ops-bot: Automated note: holdlist entries (IDs 9876-9887) created 2034980000 by commit-service. Last webhook retry 2034998000.

mia: quick diagnostic command I ran:```bash
kc get holds -n capacity-usw2 -o wide | grep billing_hold
# shows IDs 9876..9887 and reason=invoice_mismatch
```

devops-oncall: workaround considered: reassign the 3 queued burst slots to spot pools and push 6 active commitments to a temporary soft-fallback model (lower memory) to buy time. this avoids touching reserved-state.

billing-team: we'll open a finance ticket now and reprocess INVOICE-7591. If reprocess succeeds within 2h it should auto-clear the holds. I'll CC ops and post the ticket link.

leo: if reprocess fails, we can implement a one-time override script that flips tag billing_hold->pending_manual with a generated audit log. we need signoff from ingrid + finance.

ingrid: i can approve conditional override if we attach the ticket link and a rollback plan. please prepare the rollback steps.

ranjit: agreed. mia/leo, please prepare the override script + a rollback that reassigns allocations back to hold and alerts customers. billing-team, share ticket link here asap.

mia: drafting script now. will include these steps: snapshot hold IDs, run override, verify allocation, and create audit record. putting PR in infra repo and pinging security for quick signoff.

billing-team: ticket opened: FIN-42012 (reprocess INVOICE-7591). assigned to @carmen. ETA 90m initial response.

devops-oncall: temporary mitigation: moving non-critical ML training to spot us-east-1 to reduce pressure. tagging affected jobs with #resv-mitigation so SRE can track.

ranjit: thanks. let's treat this as a process gap: need better webhook retries and an alert that ties holds->invoice failures. filing a follow-up to improve automation after incident.

ops-bot: Note logged: incident-created 2035010300, incident-id CHP-2023-78, severity=medium.

sam: thanks everyone — keep updates short here. :eyes:

mia: override PR: https://git.internal/infra/holds/PR-432 — includes audit payload and rollback. awaiting ingrid signoff.

ingrid: reviewing now. if all good i'll +1 and we can run in staging before prod.

ranjit: update: finance confirmed they started reprocess. will watch both paths (reprocess and override) and pick the safer one. will update in 30m.
